title: DarkMusic 1.5.17 Release
changelog:
• Apple Music Dynamic Background: Fluid animated cover-reactive background on the now-playing screen.
• Instant Favorite Star: Tapping the star in the player immediately adds/removes favorites with zero lag.
• HD Notification Controls: High-definition notification artwork, plus instant Star and Shuffle buttons in the notification bar.
• Smooth & Natural Lyrics Scrolling: Free scrolling without accidental line clicks or phantom overlapping shadows.
• Progressive Lyrics Blur: Sharp readable upcoming line with matching contrast, followed by gentle progressive blur.
• Vocal Glow with Gentle Vibration: Sustained vocal notes glow and gently vibrate without zoom distortion, preserving Hindi and all fonts.
releaseNotes: v1.5.17: Apple Music animated background, instant favorite star, HD notification art with Star & Shuffle buttons, smooth lyrics scrolling, progressive blur, and sustained vocal glow with gentle vibration.
